baselineRule: 1984 is the first image, so no harvest, fire or loss can be dated to it: it is Unknown, never zero, and has no column.

rules.treed: VLCE2 classes 210, 220 and 230 (set A of the v3 record). Classes 20, 31, 32, 33, 40, 50, 80, 81 and 100 are not treed. Any other value in any year makes the cell Unknown for the whole record.
rules.loss: A cell treed in one year and not treed the next; the loss year is the later year. Only the latest loss of a cell is classified.
rules.cause: Fire or harvest when that raster's recorded year is within one year of the latest loss year; both when both are; not recorded otherwise. The four causes are disjoint; there is no precedence.
rules.treedAgain: Five consecutive treed years after the latest loss. A latest loss from 2018 on cannot have five treed years by 2022.
rules.harvestAndFire: Cells whose recorded harvest (or fire) year is that year, whatever their land cover, as the province series counts them.
rules.phase3: phase3UnionLossCells, phase3KnownForestCells and phase3UnknownCells are recomputed from the phase 3 rasters (forest mask 1984, the 38 annual loss rasters and the mapped extent) for the span 1984 to 2022.

fields.lostByPeriodStateCause: index (period * 3 + state) * 4 + cause; period latestLossBefore2018, latestLossFrom2018; state recovered, noReturn, unconfirmedReturn; cause notRecorded, fire, harvest, fireAndHarvest
